decisions.reason: The complete same-message MODIFY already excludes the one-off first mint from expected commission totals, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The first-mint ticket exception changes the expected ticket total, not the requirement to expose accurate metadata counters and attributes.
The accepted ticket and commission exception does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The one-off absence of a first-mint ticket does not change the sales-based countdown to the next prize draw.
The complete same-message MODIFY already records that mint #1 awards no ticket when no prior NFT exists for random selection.
The ticket-accounting exception has no effect on NFT image or media rendering behavior.
The source decision concerns first-mint ticket and commission issuance, not the display of referral counts.
The source establishes a ticket and commission exception but does not change prize-pool funding or its displayed value.
Mint #1 remains a successfully completed mint even though it generates no ticket or commission, so the public mint-counting rule is unchanged.
The one-off first-mint ticket and commission exception does not alter how recorded referral activity must be displayed.
The source changes ticket issuance for the first mint but does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw cadence, qualifying sales, or winner-selection rules.

The accepted exception may qualify the FAQ's broad statement that no-referral mints allocate tickets and commissions randomly, but the client called it a one-off with no future impact and did not specify whether public FAQ copy should mention it.
